blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Time-series multispectral imaging is widely used to assess turfgrass condition; however, extracting plot-level vegetation index (VI) values remains labor-intensive when camera positions vary between acquisitions and automated plot tracking is unreliable. We developed an open-source software tool comprising (i) a graphical user interface (GUI) for the interactive placement of orientation-adjustable regions of interest (ROIs) with $N$-way subdivision to match plot geometry and (ii) a batch-processing script that computes plot-level mean VI values from single-band floating-point rasters and exports measurements and ROI coordinates in JSON format for reuse. Saved coordinates can be reapplied to measure NDVI, NDRE, and SAVI from identical pixel regions within a single time point without re-delineating ROIs. In a demonstration using rail-mounted multispectral turfgrass imagery (18 images), plot-level mean values were extracted in a single session, with coordinates reused directly for NDRE and SAVI rasters. The system reads non-georeferenced pixel-coordinate rasters natively, does not require GIS expertise, and supports reproducible VI quantification where static sensor deployment is impractical.
blocks.zh: 时间序列多光谱成像被广泛用于评估草地状况;然而,当购买之间相机位置不同而自动地块跟踪不可靠时,提取地块水平植被指数(VI)值仍为劳动密集型. 我们开发了一个开源软件工具,包括(一) 一个图形用户界面(GUI),用于将取向调整感兴趣的区域(ROI)与美元行走分区交互放置,以匹配地块几何;(二) 一个批处理脚本,从单波段浮点光栅计算地块平面值VI,以JSON格式输出测量值和ROI坐标,供再利用。 所保存的坐标可以在单个时间点内从相同的像素区域重新应用来测量NDVI,NDRE和SAVI,而无需重新划定ROI. 在利用铁路上多光谱草地图象(18个图象)的演示中,在单场中提取出地平面平均值,坐标直接再用于NDRE和SAVI光栅. 系统在本土上读取了非地理参照的像素坐标光栅,不需要GIS专业知识,在静态传感器部署不切实际的情况下,支持可再生VI量化.

calculate vegetation indices that quantify turfgrass

blocks.en:
Research Purpose. Following the same plots across repeated images is difficult when
camera position shifts between sessions, and manually re-marking plots
is slow and inconsistent. We developed open-source software in which
users draw rotatable boxes over plots, divide them into equal sections,
and save their exact image locations.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multispectral imaging from unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and
ground-based platforms is increasingly used to monitor turfgrass
canopy condition for both research and agronomic
management ( Zhang et al., 2019 ; Ku et al., 2023 ; McLoughlin et al., 2025 ) .
Vegetation indices (VIs) derived from these images—such as the
Normalized Difference Vegetation Index
(NDVI; Rouse et al. 1974 ), the Normalized Difference Red Edge
Index (NDRE; Thompson et al. 2019 ), and the Soil-Adjusted
Vegetation Index (SAVI; Huete 1988 )—provide
quantitative summaries of canopy vigor and stress that can be tracked
longitudinally across experimental time points. While the
band-arithmetic operations needed to compute individual VIs are
straightforward, converting a large time-series collection of VI
images into database-ready, plot-level measurements is more demanding:
the same plot boundaries must be identified consistently in every
image, even when sensor position or viewing geometry shifts between
acquisitions.

blocks.en:
Geographic information system (GIS) platforms such as QGIS and
ArcGIS Pro support raster visualization and region-based zonal
statistics and are widely used for plot-level
analysis ( QGIS Development Team, 2025 ; Esri Inc., 2022 ; Wilber et al., 2022 ) . However, these
platforms are designed primarily for georeferenced spatial data with
assigned coordinate reference systems (CRS). When VI imagery is not
georeferenced—as is common with raw drone outputs and many bench-top
multispectral sensors—applying GIS zonal statistics requires
intermediate georeferencing or CRS-assignment steps that add unnecessary processing complexity. To our knowledge, neither QGIS nor
ArcGIS Pro provides a native, interactive operation for defining a
rotated parent rectangle aligned with an oblique plot row and
subdividing it into N N equal-width child regions in a single step.
When camera position shifts between time points, users must
re-delineate plot boundaries manually for each acquisition, which is both labor-intensive and highly prone to inter-session inconsistency ( Lottes and Stachniss, 2020 ) . If multiple VIs are
processed separately, slight positional differences between
independently drawn regions can introduce inter-index spatial
mismatches that complicate comparative analysis ( Li et al., 2020 ) .
Although sophisticated high-throughput phenotyping pipelines
exist ( Sun et al., 2023 ; Gano et al., 2024 ) , they typically
require substantial computational infrastructure and GIS expertise,
leaving a gap for lightweight, interactive tools suited to
small-scale experimental plots in practical field settings.

blocks.en:
We therefore developed a Python-based open-source software that standardizes plot-region definition for
non-georeferenced VI imagery and automates extraction of plot-level VI
summaries. The first component is an interactive GUI, built with
PyQt5 and OpenCV ( Riverbank Computing Limited, 2021 ; Bradski, 2000 ) , that supports
plot-geometry-aware operations: adjustable rotatable boxes and N N -way
subdivision aligned to bed geometry. The second component applies
saved JSON-encoded ROI coordinates ( Bray, 2017 ) in batch across
multiple VI images from the same time point, ensuring pixel-level
spatial identity across indices. The objective of this study was to describe the design of this system and to demonstrate, on a rail-mounted multispectral dataset, how it supports plot-level VI extraction from identical ROIs across indices
without requiring georeferenced image data.

blocks.en: 2 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 2 材料和方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Study Scenario and Input Data
blocks.zh: 2.1 研究设想和输入数据

blocks.en:
This study targets time-series turfgrass monitoring scenarios in which
repeated UAV or sensor-based acquisitions are collected at multiple
time points but imaging geometry is not perfectly reproducible between images or sessions.
Images were acquired with a Phantom 4 Multispectral (WM336, DJI) unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), equipped with six 1/2.9-inch CMOS sensors. The UAV was mounted on a ladder-rail system and moved along the table holding the turfgrass pots.
Because the UAV was translated along the rail during capture, the sensor
position differed between images. Input data consist of single-band, floating-point TIFF rasters ( *.tif / *.tiff ) representing precomputed vegetation indices—specifically NDVI, NDRE, and SAVI—derived from multispectral imagery prior to use of the proposed system ( Rouse et al., 1974 ; Thompson et al., 2019 ; Huete, 1988 ) .
Images are non-georeferenced (no CRS metadata assigned) and are
referenced in pixel coordinates only. Each time point comprises
multiple VI rasters covering the same set of turfgrass experimental
plots. As illustrated in Figure 1 , the
proposed workflow operates on these rasters to (i) define
plot-aligned measurement regions and (ii) extract plot-level summary
statistics while maintaining consistent spatial sampling across all
VIs within a time point.

The number of parent regions of interest (ROIs) per image and the subdivision count N N are

blocks.en: 2.2 System Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.2 系统架构

blocks.en:
The system consists of two Python scripts. As shown in
Figure 1 , the upper workflow handles interactive
region definition via the GUI ( Grass VI Computation Macro.py ),
per-image VI extraction, and generation of screenshots, per-image
Excel files, and JSON coordinate files. The lower workflow
( JSON to VI Computation.py ) loads the saved JSON coordinates
and applies them to additional VI rasters from the same time point,
producing per-segment VI Excel files without repeated manual ROI
placement. The GUI was implemented with PyQt5 (v5.15.4) for
interface components and OpenCV (v4.5.2) for image rendering and
geometric operations ( Riverbank Computing Limited, 2021 ; Bradski, 2000 ) . All source code is
freely available at https://github.com/kibonku/VI-ROI-Computation-Macro .

blocks.en: 2.2.3 Vegetation-Index Value Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.2.3 植被 -- -- Index 价值提取

blocks.en:
The mean VI value for each ROI is calculated by averaging the pixel values contained within the boundaries of the rotated rectangle. The ROI is rasterized as a
binary mask in image coordinate space: a pixel is included if its
center falls inside the convex polygon defined by the four vertices 𝐯 i \mathbf{v}_{i} (Eq. 1 ). Pixels carrying missing or
invalid values (IEEE NaN or a designated no-data sentinel, if
present in the input raster) are excluded from the mean. VI rasters
are read with the cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED flag to preserve
32-bit or 64-bit floating-point precision. For each processed image,
the system outputs a table of ROI identifiers and their corresponding
mean VI values.

blocks.en: 2.2.4 Coordinate Export and Reuse Across Indices
blocks.zh: 2.2.4 跨索引的坐标出口和再使用

blocks.en:
Ensuring pixel-level spatial consistency across multiple VIs within a single time point was a primary design objective. After region placement, the GUI serializes each ROI’s identifier, four corner vertices
(top-left, top-right, bottom-right, and bottom-left pixel
coordinates), and parameterized fields ( x c , y c , w , h , θ ) (x_{c},y_{c},w,h,\theta) to
a structured JSON file ( Bray, 2017 ) . The batch post-processing
script loads this JSON file and applies the stored coordinates to any
VI raster sharing the same pixel dimensions, requiring only the
substitution of the input raster path. This mechanism ensures that
NDVI, NDRE, SAVI, and any additional VI rasters from the same
acquisition are always measured over exactly the same set of pixels,
eliminating inter-index spatial discrepancies that would otherwise
arise from independently re-drawn regions.

确保像素水平的多个空间一致性 在一个时间点内的VI是首要设计目标. 在区域布局后, GUI 将每个ROI 标识符序列化, 四个角顶点
(左上右下和左下像素)
坐标)和参数化字段(x c, y c, w, h, θ) (x _{c}, y_{c}, w, h,\theta) 至
一个结构化的JSON文件(Bray, 2017). 批次后处理
脚本装入 JSON 文件, 并将存储的坐标应用到任意
六光栅共用相同的像素尺寸,只需要
替换输入光栅路径。 这一机制确保
NDVI、NDRE、SAVI以及来自同一地点的任何其他VI光栅
获取总是用完全相同的像素来测量,
消除否则会出现的索引间空间差异
源自独立重新开发的地区。

blocks.en:
To demonstrate cross-index spatial consistency, the JSON coordinate
file produced from the NDVI session was supplied as input to the
batch post-processing script along with the corresponding NDRE and
SAVI rasters from the same acquisition. No ROI re-delineation was
performed. Figure 4 shows the binary mask images
exported for NDVI (A), SAVI (B), and NDRE (C) from the same set of

same coordinates are applied to all three rasters. This avoids the
positional differences that can arise when polygons are placed
independently for each index, which may bias inter-index comparisons,
particularly at plot boundaries where index gradients are steep ( Li et al., 2020 ) .

blocks.en: 3.3 Comparison with GIS-Based Workflows
blocks.zh: 3.3 与基于地理信息系统的工作流量的比较

blocks.en:
General-purpose GIS platforms such as QGIS and ArcGIS Pro offer
raster zonal statistics functionality and Python-based batch
processing (PyQGIS and arcpy , respectively) that can in
principle automate plot-level VI extraction ( QGIS Development Team, 2025 ; Esri Inc., 2022 ; Wilber et al., 2022 ) . However, three key operational differences emerge when processing non-georeferenced, time-series multispectral imagery.
blocks.zh:
QGIS和ArcGIS Pro等通用地理信息系统平台
光栅区统计功能和基于 Python 的批次
处理(分别是PyQGIS和Arcpy),可以进入
(QGIS开发小组,2025年;Esri Inc.,2022年;Wilber等人,2022年) 然而,在处理非地理参照、时间序列的多光谱图像时,出现了三个关键的操作差异。

blocks.en:
First, zonal statistics in QGIS and ArcGIS Pro are typically performed
on rasters that carry a valid CRS, so non-georeferenced rasters may
need a CRS assigned beforehand. Assigning a CRS to such rasters adds a preparatory step for every image. In contrast, the proposed software tool reads pixel-coordinate rasters directly, without requiring any CRS assignment.
blocks.zh:
首先,典型的做法是在QGIS和ArcGIS Pro中进行分区统计。
因此非地理参照光栅可能
需要事先指定CRS。 给这些光栅指定一个CRS,为每个图像都增加了一个准备步骤. 相比之下,拟议的软件工具直接读取像素坐标光栅,而不需要任何CRS任务.

blocks.en:
Second, to our knowledge, neither QGIS nor ArcGIS Pro provides a native GUI operation to place a rotated parent rectangle over an oblique plot row and
subdivide it into N N child regions in a single interactive step.
Achieving this in QGIS requires custom scripting (via PyQGIS or the
graphical modeler), and resulting layout is not interactively adjustable
on the raster canvas in real time.
blocks.zh:
其次,据我们所知,QGIS和ArcGIS Pro都没有提供本土的GUI操作,可以将旋转的父矩形放在斜面图行上,以及
在一个互动的步骤中将其细分为N N儿童区。
在QGIS中实现这一点需要自定义脚本(通过PyQGIS或
图形建模器),其产生的布局无法交互调整
在光栅帆布上实时。

blocks.en:
Third, the JSON-based coordinate reuse mechanism ensures that all
VIs measured at a given time point utilize pixel-identical ROIs. In a conventional
GIS workflow, each VI raster is typically processed through a
separate zonal-statistics operation, requiring the same vector layer to be re-imported or re-linked for each index. While scripting can automate this process, it requires specialized GIS scripting skills that are less common in plant science laboratories.
blocks.zh:
第三,基于JSON的协调再利用机制确保所有
在特定时间点测量的VI使用像素-等同的ROIs. 在常规中
GIS工作流程,每个VI光栅一般通过一个
单独的区-统计操作,要求每个索引重新输入或重新链接相同的矢量层。 虽然脚本化可以使这一过程自动化,但它需要专门的GIS脚本化技能,这些技能在植物科学实验室中并不常见.

blocks.en: While GIS platforms remain the appropriate choice for large-scale, georeferenced spatial analysis, the proposed software tool targets a more focused use case: extracting plot-level VI data from non-georeferenced rasters when camera positions vary between sessions and GIS expertise is limited.
blocks.zh: 虽然地理信息系统平台仍然是进行大规模地理参照空间分析的适当选择,但拟议的软件工具针对一个重点更突出的使用案例:当相机位置因会议而异,地理信息系统专门知识有限时,从非地理参照光栅中提取图层六级数据。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We developed an open-source software tool to address a practical bottleneck in time-series turfgrass phenotyping: the inability to reliably re-identify the same plot regions across multispectral acquisitions when camera position is not reproducible. The interactive GUI enables users to place orientation-adjustable, N N -way subdividable ROIs directly on non-georeferenced VI rasters, avoiding the CRS-assignment step that GIS platforms typically require. The JSON-based coordinate export mechanism ensures pixel-level spatial identity across all VI layers derived from the same acquisition, preventing the inter-index spatial discrepancies that can arise when ROIs are drawn independently for each index. A demonstration on rail-mounted multispectral turfgrass imagery confirmed that plot-level VI values could be extracted in a single interactive session, with the same ROI coordinates reapplied to NDRE and SAVI rasters without additional manual input, yielding pixel-identical spatial footprints across all indices.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个开放源代码软件工具,以解决时序草丛中的一个实际瓶颈:当照相机位置无法复制时,无法可靠地重新识别多光谱采购过程中的同一地块区域。 交互式图形用户界面使用户能够将可定向调整的N-way可潜水ROI直接放置在非地理参照的VI光栅上,避免GIS平台通常需要的CRS任务步骤. 基于JSON的坐标导出机制确保了所有VI层的像素级空间身份,这些空间身份来自同一获取,防止了每个指数独立绘制ROI时可能出现的索引间空间差异. 对铁路挂载多光谱草皮图象的演示证实,地块级VI值可以在一次互动会议上提取,同样的ROI坐标重新应用于NDRE和SAVI光栅,而无需额外人工输入,从而产生所有指数的像素-等同空间足迹。

blocks.en:
Five limitations of the current system are noted.
First, no quantitative comparison of processing time or accuracy against
GIS-based workflows or fully manual delineation was performed;
such benchmarking is needed to quantify the efficiency gains.
ROI placement also remains a manual step, introducing operator subjectivity and limiting throughput for large image sets; template-matching or feature-based image registration ( Li et al., 2020 ) could in future provide an initial automated ROI estimate for the user to confirm or adjust. The demonstration relied on a single sensor and experimental setup, so validation across other sensors, spatial resolutions, and crop species is needed before broader applicability can be claimed. Additionally, the system currently reports only per-ROI mean VI values; incorporating variance, coefficient of variation, and percentile summaries would extend its utility for canopy heterogeneity analysis. Distributing the software as a self-contained executable would further reduce the installation burden for researchers without Python experience.
blocks.zh:
注意到现行制度的五个局限性。
首先,对处理时间或准确性没有进行定量比较。
进行了基于地理信息系统的工作流程或完全人工划定;
需要制定这种基准,以量化增效。
ROI的放置也仍然是一个人工步骤,引入了操作者的主观性,并限制了大型图像集的吞吐量;模板匹配或基于特征的图像注册(Li等人,2020年)今后可以为用户提供初始的自动化ROI估计,以确认或调整. 演示依赖于单一的传感器和实验设置,因此在主张更广泛的适用性之前,需要对其他传感器、空间分辨率和作物物种进行验证。 此外,本系统目前只报告每个区域办事处的平均值为VI;纳入差异、变异系数和百分率汇总将扩大其对冠状异性分析的效用。 将软件作为自成一体的可执行软件发布,将进一步减轻没有Python经验的研究者的安装负担.

blocks.en: Despite these limitations, the proposed system fills a practical gap for plant scientists who require reproducible, spatially consistent VI extraction from non-georeferenced imagery without GIS expertise. The source code is openly available, and the lightweight architecture makes it readily adaptable to other plot-scale phenotyping applications where static sensor deployment is impractical.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些限制,拟议的系统填补了植物科学家的一个实际空白,这些科学家需要从没有地理信息系统专门知识的非地理参考图象中提取可复制、空间一致的VI。 源代码是公开的,轻量级的架构使它很容易适应静态传感器部署不切实际的其他图案尺度的phenotying应用.
